description: Add, update, or remove an interface as a bridge port on a MikroTik router, and set its VLAN-filtering port settings (pvid, frameTypes, ingressFiltering) on add or update. Idempotent: add returns already_exists if the port exists with the requested settings (CONFLICT if they differ; use update), update returns no_change when nothing differs and NOT_FOUND when the interface is not a port of that bridge. Results warn when the bridge has vlan-filtering off (the settings have no effect yet) or on (a PVID change on the management port can cut the session).

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

frameTypes.description: Which frames the port admits on ingress (add/update)

ingressFiltering.description: Drop ingress frames for VLANs the port is not a member of (add/update)

interface.description: Interface to add, update or remove as a bridge port

pvid.description: Port VLAN ID for untagged ingress traffic, 1-4094 (add/update)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: manage_bridge_port
title: Manage Bridge Port
